name: Todo
description: A minimal to-do list: drag rows to reorder, red / amber / green priority dots, stored per widget
author: Lattice

sections.title: Adding and finishing
items: Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter.
Click anywhere on a row to tick it off — the whole row is the target, not just the small box.
Click it again to put it back on the list.
The counter in the title bar says how many are left, or All done.

sections.title: Priority dots
items: Click the dot to cycle: High → Medium → Low → no priority.
The first click gives High, because "this one matters" is the usual reason to mark something.
An empty circle means no priority yet — it is drawn rather than hidden so you can find it.

sections.title: Reordering
items: Drag a row up or down. It only starts moving after a few pixels, so a click still ticks it off.
Drag to the top or bottom edge and the list scrolls with you.
Press Esc in the middle of a drag to drop it back where it was.

sections.title: One list, several windows
items: Every Todo widget you place shows the same list — it is stored per widget, not per copy.
Two Todos side by side are two views of one list, not two separate lists.
If you want a second list, install a copy under a different id.

sections.title: If it cannot save
items: The counter switches to Not saved when a write fails — usually a missing storage permission.
Hover it to see the reason. The list keeps working in memory until it can write again.

changes: Drag a row to reorder; the list scrolls when you drag to an edge.
Press Esc mid-drag to drop the row back where it was.
A list that changes under your hand no longer yanks the row out of the drag.
First release: add with Enter, tick off by clicking a row, delete with ×.
Red / amber / green priority dots, one click to cycle.
